records.rule: Salience is a property/relative prominence that may influence priority; attentional capture is an outcome/process. Do not equate them.
Ease/speed of processing is not identical to accurate semantic comprehension.
Valuation can feed motivation and choice but is not synonymous with motivational state.
Reward is a psychological/learning construct; marketing 'benefit' is a product/value representation.
Do not collapse discrete emotion, valence and arousal into one latent variable.
Personal-self representations and group-based self-categorization can interact but are not identical.
Observed consensus/popularity cues may instantiate descriptive norm information, but the applied label is not automatically a separate scientific construct.
What others approve/expect and what others do are distinct signals.
Credibility judgments may contribute to trust; source trustworthiness/expertise and relational trust must be separately represented.
C4 stores psychological representation/reference effects; C7 stores deliberate message construction. Connect by edges, not duplicate nodes.
Propositional belief and evaluative attitude are related but nonidentical.
Behavioral intention is not observed behavior and must not be used as a direct substitute.
Common ground concerns information treated as shared for interaction; literal mutual knowledge is a stronger claim.
Ethos is a rhetorical category; source credibility is an empirically operationalized construct family. Do not merge automatically.
Transportation is a specific narrative construct; generic engagement metrics are not direct measures.
Readability can influence fluency but is not a direct measure of the latent construct.
'Proof' is applied copy terminology; scientific evidence evaluation must preserve source/design/uncertainty.
Influence is broader; persuasion usually implies communication-driven changes in attitudes/beliefs/behavioral dispositions.
